## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: add ...`, `fix: ...`, `docs: ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `task test` passes (and `task test-golden` / `task test-security` where the render path or the sandbox changed)
- [ ] Behaviour change? The docs are updated (and the error catalogue if error codes changed)
- [ ] `task sanitize` passes; no names, places or secrets from outside the project
